The US economy is dramatically slowing down, but Trump is still focused on expanding his illegal war in Iran.

The American people do not want this to continue. It's why the House passed my bipartisan War Powers Resolution last week. Trump must end this war.

posts.text: I just spoke to the FBI Special Agent in Charge for the region regarding last night's shooting. I thanked him for having law enforcement on the scene immediately, and he confirmed that they stand ready to assist SPD—which remains the lead agency for the investigation— should the FBI's capabilities be required. I will continue to help coordinate any federal resources that may be necessary, and will closely monitor updates with the City of Seattle.
posts.summary: Coordinates law enforcement response to shooting, emphasizes FBI-SPD cooperation
